OpenIddict.//SigningKeys: Key material comes from OpenIddict__SigningKeys__Path (an RSA keypair on a mounted volume, so the JWKS kid survives redeploy and issued JWTs keep validating) or, for stateless pods where every consumer can re-auth on demand, OpenIddict__UseEphemeralKeys=true. Startup fails unless one is set - deliberately left unset here so that guard fires instead of being satisfied by a placeholder. There is no OpenIddict:Server:SigningKey/EncryptionKey; those were read by nothing (andy-auth#152).

//Mcp: Set Mcp__ResourceIdentifier to the RFC 9728 `resource` identifier published at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. It must match what clients send in the RFC 8707 `resource` parameter. Left unset here so the request-origin fallback applies rather than a literal placeholder leaking into the metadata document (andy-auth#155).

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Issue #125. TrustAllProxies=false so forwarded headers are honoured ONLY when the immediate peer is in KnownNetworks. On Railway the app is reachable solely through Railway's HTTPS edge, which OVERWRITES inbound X-Forwarded-* and connects to the container over the private network below, so an external client cannot forge its IP/scheme. Adjust KnownNetworks (or set TrustAllProxies=true via ForwardedHeaders__TrustAllProxies) if the platform's proxy range differs.

SecurityHeaders._comment: Issue #128. CSP enabled by default in Production; the policy is nonce-based (see Program.cs) so Razor views render without 'unsafe-inline' script/style elements.
